result.reasoning: This commit ("Add RBD support for primary storage") introduced the RBDStringBuilder method in KVMPhysicalDisk.java with the line `rbdOpts += ":mon_host=" + monHost + "\\\\:" + monPort;`, using a double-escaped backslash (`\\\\`) instead of the correct single escape (`\\`). This double-escape bug persisted (later split into a separate `if (monPort > 0)` block by commit fb9ceba93bbd, which preserved the same erroneous `\\\\:` string) until the fix commit d33e5278b211753ac3d46acb7d6213f3ae75e087 corrected it to `\\:`. The core buggy logic — the incorrect escape sequence — originates here, not in the later commit that merely restructured the surrounding conditional.
